subject: textures DELTA8 exact remaining ABI/wiring for MSAA + T2
body:
Current DELTA8 implementation is committed and validated on C6h:
- n2r v3 fields: sample_counts (all1/4), resolves (address0 none); framebuffer sample_count/pattern, rotated4 LUT, tile allocation via n2r_tib_bytes*samples, writeback_msaa SINGLE/LAYERED/AVERAGE, exact target/resolve validation.
- T2 n2r target mapping: 90/94 10-bit, 65/25 float16, 55/125/30/110 raw/16-unorm, plus existing 70/80/115 and C6g 43. Sampling via n2t already supports 90/94/65/25/55/125/30/110. XR 552/553/554/555 remain n2r_bpp=0 explicit refusals; enabled blend on the newly admitted 10-bit/raw targets is refused (disabled descriptor only for raw).
- Tests current: 15/15 release+ASan on committed tree; hashes n2r ebb019f2..., header 58e1d9fe..., worker test 1e365a66...; evidence-delta8.txt 3633c95f...
Compute/render integration asks remain:
1) n2mb_render_targets mirror sample_counts/resolves under version3; retain resolve BOs with write; pass sidecar version unchanged.
2) render true-MRT MSAA must populate sample_counts/resolves, sample4+resolve only, exact format/row/size; no partial fallback.
3) T2 render-target admission in Rust planner/render currently not wired for 90/94/65/25/55/125/30/110; n2r can represent them, but air_bridge/render must admit the exact lists. Sampling sidecar paths also need planner acceptance.
No phone/native/publish/commit.
